message.content: {"note_claim": "The first step on the Moon was filmed with a pre-positioned camera in the lunar module, and transmitted low-resolution slow-scan TV at 10 fps.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Positioning the camera in the MESA made it possible to telecast the astronauts' first steps as they climbed down the LM's ladder… these slow-scan television (SSTV) cameras, running at 10 frames per second (fps)", "reason": "The page directly confirms both that the camera was pre-positioned in the lunar module's MESA to capture the first steps and that the Apollo 11 camera transmitted slow-scan TV at 10 fps."}

parsed.note_claim: The first step on the Moon was filmed with a pre-positioned camera in the lunar module, and transmitted low-resolution slow-scan TV at 10 fps.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Positioning the camera in the MESA made it possible to telecast the astronauts' first steps as they climbed down the LM's ladder… these slow-scan television (SSTV) cameras, running at 10 frames per second (fps)
parsed.reason: The page directly confirms both that the camera was pre-positioned in the lunar module's MESA to capture the first steps and that the Apollo 11 camera transmitted slow-scan TV at 10 fps.
